name: application-compose-window
title: Compose Window
description: Floating, dockable email compose window with a title bar (minimize/close), To/Subject fields, a message body textarea, and a footer with Send and delete-draft actions.
useWhen: Building a Gmail-style docked compose window that floats above the main content and can be minimized or closed.
You need dedicated To/Subject header fields plus a full message body, not just a single reply textarea.
Distinct from Comment Composer, which is an inline reply box attached to a thread rather than a standalone floating window with its own To/Subject fields.
avoidWhen: Replying inline within an existing comment or discussion thread — use Comment Composer instead.
The message has no separate subject/recipient concept (like a chat message) — a simple composer input is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The window keeps a fixed width and anchors to the bottom-right of its container; the body textarea is the only element that would scroll on overflow.
accessibility: Minimize, close, and delete-draft icon-only buttons all carry aria-label since their content is an SVG glyph.
To/Subject inputs use real <label htmlFor> associations rather than placeholder-only labeling.
The body textarea carries an aria-label since it has no visible adjacent label.

variants.title: Compose Window
variants.description: Docked compose window with a dark title bar, To/Subject fields, a pre-filled body, and Send/delete-draft footer actions.
accessibility: Minimize and close controls are keyboard-focusable buttons with descriptive aria-labels.

variants.title: Compose Window (Dark)
variants.description: The same compose window adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Field and button contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
